info.title: Lavbe administration API
info.description: Design contract, not an implemented service. All /admin API responses no-store; no wildcard CORS. Cookie-authenticated mutations require Origin, X-CSRF-Token. Runner endpoints use independent short-lived scoped bearer credential. Record schemas depend on kind and must be validated, never accepted as arbitrary executable code.

post.description: Login requires valid password and TOTP, same-origin Origin check and login rate limiting. Session cookie is Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax. No session CSRF token required before login.
